'''Shool's Club''' was a private club in [[Byrne City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]], catering exclusively to the manager class. It was near the heart of the [[City/Legends|city]] next to the central shopping plaza, and included a health spa and dance establishment. It was destroyed in the [[Demophon supernova]].<ref name="BE" />
